reply.text:
That one's outside what I'll coach. Running a cycle of HGH is dosing a drug, and I don't give amounts, schedules or stacking advice for hormones. It's a conversation for a doctor who can look at your bloodwork and your health.

What I can do is the training side. If you're chasing more size, strength or better recovery, tell me the goal and I'll have the engine build you a block around it. Sleep, eating enough and steady progression do more than most people expect.
